cores.textbox: When this defends, **clash** with the attacking hero. The winner creates an Agility token.

faces.printed_rules_text: When this defends, **clash** with the attacking hero. The winner creates an Agility token. _(Clashing heroes reveal the top card of their deck. The hero that reveals the card with greatest {p} wins.)_
rules_text_html: When this defends, clash with the attacking hero. The winner creates an Agility token. (Clashing heroes reveal the top card of their deck. The hero that reveals the card with greatest wins.)

product.description:
The smell hits you first. Blood… Sweat… Steel…

Feral crowds roar loud as the thumping in your chest. You step into the arena, hot sand billowing at your feet. Drinks are poured, wagers are made, weapons are drawn…

Gold and glory is yours for the taking… If you survive the Deathmatch Arena!
